text: The tag-controller reland adds explicit FeedUtils imports to mailContext.js and about3Pane.js and removes the latter lazy getter. The context script no longer relies on the newsblog overlay’s global declaration. This dependency change belongs to the parent tag reland, before the following context-menu system-module port. The accepted source keeps both imports. This is a scoped shared-script integration choice, not a rule against lazy module getters or proof of a reproduced property-definition error. No window, browser or build test ran.
title: The tag reland gives each shared window script its own FeedUtils import
